name: @arkimedehq/recordare-openai-proxy
description: Recordare memory proxy: an OpenAI-compatible proxy that gives chat platforms without plugin hooks (AnythingLLM, Open WebUI, LibreChat) long-term memory — capture of every turn and recall before each answer.
author: Andrea Genovese

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && esbuild src/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --alias:@arkimedehq/recordare-client=../../packages/client/src/index.ts --metafile=dist/meta.json --outfile=dist/main.js --banner:js="import { createRequire as __recordareCreateRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = __recordareCreateRequire(import.meta.url);" && node ../scripts/bundle-licenses.mjs dist/meta.json dist/THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.txt && rm dist/meta.json
